article.title: 4 [Punishment for abetment of offences.
article.content: Whoever abets any offence punishable under this Act, whether or not that offence is committed in consequence of that abetment, shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than three years, but which may extend to seven years and shall also be liable to fine.]
article.html:
124[Punishment for abetment of offences.

Section 12 · Chapter III · page 10 of the Act

Whoever abets any offence punishable under this Act, whether or not that offence is committed in consequence of that abetment, shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than three years, but which may extend to seven years and shall also be liable to fine.]

4 Subs. by Act 16 of 2018, s. 6, for s. 12 (w.e.f. 26-7-2018).
